cats.label: Rifle
cats.note: Assault rifles and carbines, one shared profile across every faction.

cats.label: Battle rifle
cats.note: Full-power semi-autos. Triple the punch on a close pass, gone by 2 m.

cats.label: DMR
cats.note: Scoped marksman rifles. Enormous close-pass power, a 2.0 ceiling.

cats.label: Sniper rifle
cats.note: Bolt actions and heavy semi-autos. The hardest single round in the game.

cats.label: LSW
cats.note: Squad automatic weapons on the light support profile.

cats.label: LMG
cats.note: Belt-fed 5.56. The flattest curve, still working at 6 m.

cats.label: MMG
cats.note: 7.62 general-purpose guns. Widest envelope at 7 m and a 1.75 ceiling.

cats.label: SMG / pistol
cats.note: Submachine guns, sidearms and subsonics. The weakest passby in the game.

cats.label: Shotgun / HMG
cats.note: Shotguns and the KS-23 sit on flat, curve-free profiles: full power at any distance.

cats.label: Explosive
cats.note: Launched ordnance. Zero passby power; suppresses radially on detonation instead.

cats.label: No suppression
cats.note: Smoke and signalling rounds. No suppression at all.
